india_trends.title: NSE IPO: Bank of Baroda to divest up to 35% of holding in National Stock Exchange through OFS in exchange’s public offer
india_trends.summary: Bank of Baroda plans to sell up to 76,90,375 equity shares, representing 35% of its shareholding in the NSE, through an Offer for Sale as part of the IPO, pending regulatory approvals. The transaction is expected to complete by the end of September 2026.

RBI overnight cash withdrawal auction: Banks park ₹3.53 lakh crore after tepid 30-day auction
india_trends.summary: On 7 September, banks showed limited interest in the RBI’s VRRR auctions, submitting bids below the notified amounts. A second auction for overnight funds saw stronger participation, indicating banks prefer shorter parking periods.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Fed's Waller signals patience on rates, but keeps hike on table if inflation heats up
india_trends.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller is inclined to remain patient on interest rates, influenced by upcoming inflation data. He noted he might consider a rate hike if inflation data shows progress towards the 2% goal, acknowledging some signs of disinflation.

india_trends.title: Raghuram Rajan clarifies his stand on GDP: If growth is strong, why aren’t private investment, FDI and jobs rising?
india_trends.summary: Raghuram Rajan stated he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's GDP growth figures. He expressed confusion over the economy’s growth not leading to increased private investment, FDI, or job creation.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Goyal calls for nationwide push to unlock export benefits under FTAs
india_trends.summary: Addressing a national workshop in New Delhi on leveraging free trade agreements, commerce minister Piyush Goyal said India's nine FTAs currently cover economies representing about $60 trillion in GDP and provide preferential access to nearly two-thirds of global trade.

india_trends.title: Neelkanth Mishra rejects base-revision concerns over 7.8% GDP growth, says, 'several indicators hard to manipulate'
india_trends.summary: Neelkanth Mishra of the World Bank defended India's 7.8% GDP growth, asserting that claims questioning its accuracy are incorrect.

india_trends.title: Mint Explainer | What is the confusion over GDP growth numbers?
india_trends.summary: Opposition parties and some experts have questioned the government's latest GDP data. Mint examines the allegations and whether there is any merit to the concerns.

india_trends.title: India GDP debate: Why 7.8% growth rate isn’t final, and 2.6% misses the math
india_trends.summary: A methodological shift and routine revisions to India's GDP data have caused confusion over official statistics and critics' claims, even as headline growth struggles to lift living standards.

india_trends.title: India’s services sector expands in August, but growth at four-year low, PMI survey shows
india_trends.summary: Services activity accelerated in August, but weak new-business growth and intense competition kept the sector’s expansion near its weakest level in more than four years, even as hiring hit a 15-month high.

india_trends.title: Who is Subhash Chandra Garg? All about ex‑finance secretary questioning India’s 7.8% GDP growth
india_trends.summary: In July 2019, Garg took voluntary retirement from service, a day after he was moved to the Power Ministry in a broader reshuffle just three weeks after the presentation of the Union Budget. Garg's scheduled retirement was in October 2020.

india_trends.summary: India's residential real estate sector is entering the middle stage of its current cycle, with developers shifting focus from debt reduction to capital deployment, project execution and development of annuity assets, according to a report by Nuvama Research.
